chosen_direction.belongs_to_book_one: (1) Morning-climb: every panel sun sits low with an upward fan (Panel III grammar); Book One never reaches zenith. (2) Herd-vs-noble skirmishes (p3c1 herd/ebb-flood, p3c3 wink, p3c21 tablets, p3c50 ringfaces, p3c53 dim eye, p3c55 altar) are staged as emblems under ONE climbing sun: skirmish is content, morning is arena. (3) Theatrical set-pieces p3c22 (staged court-day), p3c30 (comedy of famous), p3c36 (falling Roman masks) + p3c29 (French unities) share the Footlights family + stage tone, framed by p3c1 comedy/tragedy and p3c54 dead mask. (4) Epicurean noon-flash p3c45 (afternoon of antiquity, whitish sea) breaks cohort light exactly once: a noon flash-forward legible only against 55 mornings. (5) Sleepwalker climax p3c54 resolves into DANCE (dance of spirits, earthly dance, master of ceremony): landmark panel reintroduces cover vermilion leapers, handing Book One to the book dance grammar; p3c56 conjured monster faces the horizon toward Book Two masks (Panel IV).

chosen_direction.name: C — Morning Field-Work: the Emblem Cabinet (CHOSEN, within NOON)
principles: One mural hand: flat fills, round-cap strokes, Matisse-grammar gestures; no gradients (theme-safe x8).
Fixed morning light: sun always climbs low; only p3c45 breaks it (noon), p3c48 dims it (distress). Light is narrative.
Content-assigned everything: every symbol/tone/scale from observed prose; zero index-derived variation.
Boldness in one place: authored art + designed controls. Zero cohort animation (art.css owns meta motion).
Theatre as family not house: Footlights motifs serve stage chapters inside NOON.

direction_comparison.verdict: REJECTED: (1) altitude-by-index is order-derived, modulo/hash-adjacent, violates RELAUNCH spirit; (2) 56 imperceptible variants = the rejected weak-change failure; (3) 56 variants are 56 illustrations, not a one-file symbol system.

direction_comparison.name: B — Footlights (against NOON: stagecraft house)
direction_comparison.summary: Full theatre rebuild: footlight rows, valances, masks, prompter box, applause fans; sun becomes spotlight, sea the dark house. True to p3c22/p3c30/p3c36 + comedy/tragedy frame (p3c1, p3c54 dead mask).

chapters_1_14.r: Programmatic opener, longest (1239w): herd instinct as species-essence, ebb-and-flood law, comedy/tragedy as preservation. Grandest panel.
Lonely conscience watches the majority handle scales with underweight weights; tilted balance is the one concrete image.
Common natures wink at nobility, suspect advantage, laugh at the sparkle in the noble eye: the eternal injustice of the noble.
Strongest evil spirits rekindle dozing passions, topple boundary stones; flame catching on cold embers.
Pathos-merchants need the unconditional ought as drumbeat: Mazzini, categorical imperative, mouthed principles.
Reflection lost ceremony; unstoppable head-machine thinks while walking. Striding head with works inside.
Immense unploughed field of moral study: unwritten histories of love/avarice/envy, toward future cyclops-buildings.
Real virtues hide like sculptures on reptile scales, visible only under a microscope not yet invented.
Feeble traits erupt into light centuries later; hidden gardens within. Sprout breaking soil.
Rare humans are late ghosts of past cultures to nurse and honour, at an andante tempo of development.
Consciousness the latest unfinished organ; making knowledge instinctive only dawning on the human eye. Raw ember eye.
Pleasure/displeasure intertwined: jubilation unto heaven requires grief unto death. Two crossing strands.
Benefiting/hurting both power exercised; pain asks its cause, pleasure stops with itself. Extended hand over dependents and equals.
Greed/love one instinct named twice; outstretched hands while the most beautiful landscape tires in three months; friendship as higher thirst.

chapters_15_28.r: Mountain enchants only from below and distance; climb it and magic dies. Silhouette + tiny climber.
'Do you want to cross the footbridge to me?' refused, until mountains and torrents divide. The bridge is the story.
Wise gardener lays the poor stream in a nymph's arms to dignify it. Trickle cradled; quiet for 97w.
Ancient nobility's hue needed distance: the Greek barely saw the slave, not even Plato. Now flattened by equality.
No proud tree without storms; poison killing the weak strengthens the strong. Windswept tree, quiet.
Under coming tyranny of prudence, to be noble = entertain follies. Cap outlasting ledger.
'Teachers of...' pair with p3c1 (957w): virtues praised for society's use while dominating possessors; self-refuting Thou-shalt/Thou-shalt-not.
Most formally eccentric: staged court-day monologue, bad weather unspoken, Montaigne's stone, five-o'clock bell, world improvising.
Corruption as a people's autumn: colourful superstition vs pale faith, Napoleon's 'That is me,' apples as seed-bearers of future.
Weak discontents take opiates (beautiful); strong take physicians (better). Wine cup vs medicine cup.
Stupid humility turns on heel from the striking: 'too many old truths.' Averted profile, quiet.
Life = continual shedding of what wants to die, against Moses' 'thou shalt not kill.' Slough, quiet 67w.
Renouncer casts ballast to soar higher, hiding pride under the hood: secretly an affirmer.
Strengths outrun weaknesses; the great destroy the weak precisely with their best (overly potent drink). The morning sun overexposed IS the blinding best.

chapters_29_42.r: French unities quarrel: conservatives invent reasons for old habits after the fact. Prompter whispering excuses.
Famous men borrow splendour/fear/feigned idleness from a rotating cast whose surroundings die off. Plumes + mask duet.
Trade common as reading, as hunting once was; nobles may one day trade as luxury of sentiment. Bow over scale duet.
Corrupter rejects two disciples: cannot say no / says half-and-half; doctrine needs a warlike soul.
Man became distrustful, more evil, late: 'because he now has a science.' Cold suspicion-wink rhymes p3c3.
Great humans exert retroactive force: secrets crawl into his sunshine; past still undiscovered.
Thinking otherwise = heresy, witchcraft's adjunct; Reformation redoubled medieval spirit consciencelessly. Stake + snapped halo.
Augustus lets mask fall (plaudite amici); Nero qualis artifex; Tiberius silent, smothered into double death. Roman theatre landmark.
Science promoted through three errors: God (Newton), utility (Voltaire), innocence (Spinoza). Three candles, quiet.
Young men powder kegs thrilled by the burning match of zeal, never the cause.
Taste changes before opinions when shameless ones enforce hoc est ridiculum. Tipped cup.
Military culture above industrial: workers sell selves to unknown employers. Sword vs chimney, stern iron.
Thinker treats acts as experiments; success/failure are answers; remorse belongs to the ordered-about.
Against work-for-wages: rare ones (artists, hunters, travellers, lovers) for whom work is the reward of rewards.

chapters_43_56.r: Penal codes betray what a people finds foreign: Wahhabis' two mortal sins, old Romans. Tablet cracked by foreign wedge.
Believed-in motives matter more than motives: imagined levers of happiness/misery. Lever gripped by shadow.
Afternoon of antiquity: calm eye over whitish sea, sun-bathed rocks, creatures in light, existence grown still. The single noon-flash.
Voluptuous amazement science's results stand: inner life once clamped with eternal necessity; now shipwrecked men on firm earth.
Forbidding passion's expression (Louis XIV court) atrophies passion into graceful shallowness. Muzzled court mouth.
Darkest essay: ages divided by knowledge of distress, long age of fear, cruelty-to-self as training; recipe: distress. Dimmed rays, iron ring.
Magnanimity centrifugal: sudden satiety/nausea flings feeling to opposites (cold/laughter/tears) with revenge's egoism.
Fear of a cold look outweighs conscience: dread of growing solitary is herd instinct speaking. One figure, ring of faces.
Shortest (55w): flint-strike 'Let's try it!' or silence, where courage keeps its right. Single spark, nothing more.
What others know assails from outside; bad reputation outweighs bad conscience. Mouths + echo waves.
Duller the eye, more extensive the good: cheerful common vs gloomy thinkers. Dim eye closes eye-rhyme p3c11/p3c45.
Philosophical climax: ancient fabulating within; sleepwalker must dream lest fall; appearance no dead mask; knower joins dance of spirits as master of ceremony.
Nobility = singularity: heat in cold things, values without scale, altars of unknown god, courage without honours. Lone flame.
Closer: bored young Europe invents emergencies, conjures a horizon monster to fight in advance. Ember horizon hands to Book Two.

landmarks.why: Opener + longest (1239w) + programmatic (herd, ebb-flood, 'We, too, have our time!'). Grandest panel/title proportional to text.
'Teachers of...' pair w/ p3c1, 957w; virtues dominate possessors; self-refuting ought. Monumental iron, formally unique.
Most formally eccentric: staged court-day monologue. Formal, not length, motive.
Roman masks: Augustus plaudite, Nero artifex, Tiberius smothered double death. 224w but densest theatre cluster: landmark by semantics.
Most luminous image (123w): whitish sea, sun-bathed rocks, still existence. Rule exists to BREAK cohort light once: only noon panel + only gold title.
Philosophical climax resolving into book's dance grammar (master of ceremony). Dream panel + leapers hand Book One onward.

Strong closer but single-emblem 231w; closing tone + 128px mark + ember wash give closer-weight without a chapter rule. Length-ranked landmarks (p3c23 980w) refused: landmarks are formal/semantic events.
